papers.title: Efficacy and safety of oral orforglipron in Japanese participants with obesity disease (ATTAIN-J): a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, phase 3 trial
papers.take: Oral non-peptide GLP-1 RA gives modest placebo-adjusted weight loss in a Japanese obesity-disease population, with a dose plateau above 12 mg.
papers.result: 72 wk weight change −5.9 to −8.7% vs −0.6% placebo

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of low-dose IL-2 in people with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes (DIABIL-2): a double-blind, multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 2b trial
papers.take: Clear Treg target engagement but no preservation of C-peptide at 12 months — a negative trial for IL-2 monotherapy at diagnosis.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of co-administered cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema) 1·7 mg each and 1·0 mg each in adults with overweight or obesity (REDEFINE 9): a phase 3b trial
papers.take: Lower CagriSema doses (1.0 and 1.7 mg each) achieve ~21% weight loss, essentially matching the 2.4 mg dose — relevant to tolerability-driven dosing.

papers.title: Petrelintide, a human amylin analogue for the treatment of obesity (ZUPREME 1): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2 trial
papers.take: Amylin monotherapy gives ~8% placebo-adjusted weight loss at 28 wk with notably low vomiting/diarrhoea — a tolerability-differentiated non-incretin option.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of mazdutide in adults with obesity or overweight: a US-based, multicentre, phase 2, randomised, placebo-controlled clinical trial
papers.take: Glucagon/GLP-1 co-agonist reaches ~17% placebo-adjusted loss at 32 wk at 16 mg, but 20% GI-driven discontinuation at top dose.

papers.title: Long-term safety of oral orforglipron in Japanese participants with type 2 diabetes (ACHIEVE-J): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, parallel-group phase 3 trial
papers.take: 52-week safety study without a comparator arm effect; discontinuation for AEs rises to 14% at 36 mg, no severe hypoglycaemia.

papers.title: Once-weekly IcoSema versus once-daily insulin glargine U100 in type 2 diabetes management (COMBINE 4): an open-label, multicentre, treat-to-target, randomised, phase 3b trial
papers.take: For insulin-naive T2D, weekly icodec+semaglutide beats daily glargine on HbA1c, weight and hypoglycaemia — a credible single-injection-per-week initiation step.
papers.result: HbA1c ETD −0.88 pp; weight ETD −4.6 kg; hypo RR 0.56

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly semaglutide 2·4 mg in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity (STEP 12): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3b trial
papers.take: Semaglutide 2.4 mg effective at Asian-specific BMI cut-points (24–30), supporting lower-threshold eligibility in Asian populations.

papers.title: Effect of semaglutide on kidney outcomes in the SELECT, FLOW, and SOUL trials: a prespecified pooled analysis
papers.take: Participant-level pooling of three outcome trials shows semaglutide lowers a kidney composite across diabetes and non-diabetes populations.

papers.title: Nutritional, functional, and psychological considerations for incretin-based therapies in adults — an EASO, EFAD, and ECPO Consensus Statement
papers.take: European consensus on protein targets, resistance exercise and psychological screening during incretin therapy — directly usable for clinic workflows and patient counselling.

papers.title: Human versus analogue insulin for children and young adults with type 1 diabetes in low-resource settings (HumAn-1): a multicentre, open-label, randomised controlled trial
papers.take: In Bangladesh, switching to glargine did not reduce time in very low range or improve TIR vs usual human insulin at 6 months — challenges analogue-first assumptions where cost binds.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema) in adults with type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on diet and exercise (REIMAGINE 1): a phase 3a study
papers.take: CagriSema as first-line injectable in early T2D lowers HbA1c ~1.7 pp vs placebo with weight loss.
papers.result: 40 wk HbA1c ETD −1.7 pp (2.4 mg) / −1.3 pp (1.0 mg)

papers.title: Cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema) versus semaglutide or cagrilintide in people with type 2 diabetes (REIMAGINE 2): a double-blind, randomised, controlled, phase 3 study
papers.take: Adding cagrilintide to semaglutide 2.4 mg adds only a small HbA1c increment (−0.16 pp) in T2D; the case for the combination rests on weight, not glycaemia.
papers.result: HbA1c ETD vs sema 2.4 mg −0.16 pp (−0.27 to −0.05)

papers.title: Effects of a 6-week subcutaneous infusion of native GIP alone or as add-on to semaglutide in people with type 2 diabetes: a randomised, placebo-controlled trial
papers.take: Native GIP added to semaglutide did not improve glycaemia — informs the debate on whether GIP agonism or antagonism drives tirzepatide-type benefit.
papers.result: Sensor glucose diff 0.05 mmol/L with sema+GIP (NS)

papers.title: Type 1 diabetes intervention clusters in resource-limited settings: a systematic review and economic evaluation
papers.take: Bundled interventions (integrated care, technology-enhanced self-management) outperform single interventions; mHealth is the most cost-effective single component.

papers.title: A comparison of the effects of tirzepatide and dulaglutide on major kidney events in people with type 2 diabetes: pre-specified exploratory analyses of the SURPASS-CVOT trial
papers.take: Versus an active GLP-1 RA comparator, tirzepatide lowered major kidney events, mainly via less new macroalbuminuria — exploratory, but head-to-head.

papers.title: Continuous glucose monitoring versus self-monitoring of blood glucose in individuals with type 2 diabetes: a randomised, multicentre, open-label, superiority trial
papers.take: Real-time CGM beats SMBG for basal-insulin-treated T2D, both self-managed and clinician-supported, with a durable ~0.5 pp HbA1c gain.
papers.result: HbA1c diff −0.6 pp (16 wk), −0.5 pp (32 wk)

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of co-administered cagrilintide and semaglutide versus semaglutide alone in adults with overweight or obesity with or without type 2 diabetes in Japan and Taiwan (REDEFINE 5): a phase 3a trial
papers.take: Head-to-head, CagriSema adds ~6.5 pp weight loss over semaglutide 2.4 mg in an East Asian population.

papers.title: Tubeless automated insulin delivery versus multiple daily injections in children and adults with type 1 diabetes with elevated HbA1c (RADIANT): a multicentre, international, randomised, controlled trial
papers.take: Direct MDI-to-tubeless-AID switch lowers HbA1c 0.8 pp in 13 weeks without a pump-first step — supports AID as first-line technology for T1D above target.
papers.result: HbA1c diff −0.8% (−1.0 to −0.6); no severe hypo/DKA

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of relacorilant for the treatment of patients with Cushing's syndrome (GRACE): a multicentre, phase 3, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomised-withdrawal study
papers.take: Selective GR antagonist maintains BP control in responders to open-label therapy; enriched randomised-withdrawal design limits generalisability, and no cortisol-lowering endpoint applies.

papers.title: 3 months vs 12 months of romosozumab for postmenopausal osteoporosis (LIDA): an open-label, non-inferiority, randomised controlled trial
papers.take: 3 months of romosozumab then denosumab matched 12 months of romosozumab for hip BMD — small, surrogate-endpoint trial, but a cost/access lever worth watching.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of inclisiran in adolescents with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia (ORION-16): a two-part, randomised, multicentre clinical trial
papers.take: Twice-yearly inclisiran lowers LDL ~28% vs placebo in adolescents with HeFH, sustained to 2 years.

papers.title: Effect of intensive blood pressure control on cognitive outcomes and brain structures in adults with type 2 diabetes: prespecified analysis of secondary outcomes of BPROAD randomised controlled trial
papers.take: SBP target <120 vs <140 in T2D did not reduce dementia/MCI over ~4 years, though white-matter lesion accrual slowed.

papers.title: Retatrutide, a Triple Hormone Receptor Agonist, for Treatment of Obesity
papers.take: First phase 3 of a triple agonist: ~21 pp placebo-adjusted weight loss at top dose — highest pharmacological efficacy reported — with OA pain and OSA benefits.

papers.title: Oral small-molecule GLP-1RA safiglipron versus dapagliflozin in type 2 diabetes: a randomized, double-blind, active-comparator-controlled phase 3 trial
papers.take: A second oral small-molecule GLP-1 RA (no fasting needed) is non-inferior to and modestly better than dapagliflozin on HbA1c.

papers.title: Effects of semaglutide on kidney disease in type 2 diabetes: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
papers.take: Mechanistic trial: semaglutide did not change MRI oxygenation/perfusion/inflammation coprimaries; secondary haemodynamic and transcriptomic signals point to vascular and anti-inflammatory effects.

papers.title: Oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist safiglipron in early type 2 diabetes: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
papers.take: In early diet-treated T2D, safiglipron lowers HbA1c ~1.2–1.5 pp vs placebo.

papers.title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Non-Insulin-Treated Type 2 Diabetes
papers.take: CGM in non-insulin-treated T2D in primary care lowered HbA1c 0.9 pp and raised TIR 21 pp — strengthens the case for extending CGM funding beyond insulin users.

papers.title: Cardiovascular safety of orforglipron versus insulin glargine in adults with type 2 diabetes at increased cardiovascular risk (ACHIEVE-4): a phase 3, event-driven, randomised, non-inferiority trial
papers.take: Orforglipron is CV-safe vs glargine (MACE-4 non-inferior, point estimate favourable) — clears the regulatory bar but is not a superiority CVOT.

papers.title: Retatrutide in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes (TRIUMPH-2): a double-blind, parallel-group, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
papers.take: In obesity with T2D, retatrutide gives ~12–14 pp placebo-adjusted loss — smaller than without diabetes, as with every incretin class.

papers.title: Survodutide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Adults with Obesity
papers.take: Glucagon/GLP-1 co-agonist gives ~7–8 pp placebo-adjusted loss at 76 wk with very high GI AE rates (81–90%) — underwhelming against tirzepatide.

papers.title: Lifestyle and Metformin Interventions and Risk of Multimorbidity in Adults With Prediabetes
papers.take: Decades on, DPP lifestyle (not metformin) arm had ~20% lower multimorbidity, even excluding diabetes — a legacy effect, though follow-up is observational.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly subcutaneous zenagamtide, a novel unimolecular GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonist, in type 2 diabetes: a phase 2 trial
papers.take: Single-molecule GLP-1/amylin agonist lowers HbA1c up to 1.6 pp vs placebo in phase 2.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of once-daily oral zenagamtide, a novel unimolecular GLP-1 and amylin receptor agonist, in adults with type 2 diabetes: a phase 2 trial
papers.take: Oral formulation of the same co-agonist: ~1 pp HbA1c reduction at higher doses.

papers.title: Orforglipron Added to Titrated Insulin Glargine in Type 2 Diabetes: The ACHIEVE-5 Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.take: Oral orforglipron added to titrated glargine gives ~1 pp further HbA1c reduction with weight loss.

papers.title: Treatment With 9-mg Mazdutide for Weight Reduction in Chinese Adults With Obesity: The GLORY-2 Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.take: In young Chinese adults, mazdutide 9 mg yields ~15 pp placebo-adjusted loss at 60 wk with low AE discontinuation (2.9%).

papers.title: Survodutide in adults with obesity and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial
papers.take: Glucagon co-agonism shows its liver-specific edge: 84% achieved ≥30% liver-fat reduction vs 24% on placebo.

papers.title: Oral small molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist aleniglipron in people with overweight or obesity: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2b trial
papers.take: Third oral small-molecule GLP-1 RA in the race: up to 11 pp placebo-adjusted loss at 36 wk.

papers.title: An AI-Based OCT System to Detect Diabetic Macular Edema: A Prospective Validation and Noninferiority Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.take: AI triage of OCT cut false-positive DME referrals from 69% to 24% with no loss of sensitivity — a deployable screening-pathway efficiency gain.

papers.title: Weight Loss in Older Patients With Persistent Atrial Fibrillation: The LOSE-AF Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.take: ~10% behavioural weight loss in older adults with persistent AF did not improve symptoms or AF burden — tempers extrapolation from younger cohorts.

papers.title: [177Lu]Lu-edotreotide versus everolimus for gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumours (COMPETE): a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, open-label, superiority trial
papers.take: PRRT beats everolimus on PFS with fewer treatment-related AEs — supports earlier-line radioligand therapy in progressive GEP-NETs.

papers.title: Teriparatide Plus Zoledronic Acid for Osteogenesis Imperfecta: A Randomized Clinical Trial
papers.take: Adult OI: BMD rose but fractures did not fall — a clean demonstration that BMD gains do not translate to fracture benefit in collagen disorders.

papers.title: Orforglipron compared with dapagliflozin in adults with type 2 diabetes and inadequate glycaemic control with metformin (ACHIEVE-2): a phase 3 trial
papers.take: On metformin background, orforglipron outperforms dapagliflozin on HbA1c (up to −0.75 pp) at the cost of more AE discontinuation.

papers.title: Setmelanotide for the Treatment of Acquired Hypothalamic Obesity
papers.take: First phase 3 positive trial for acquired hypothalamic obesity (e.g. post-craniopharyngioma): ~20 pp BMI reduction vs placebo.

papers.title: Comparative effects of drugs for adults with overweight or obesity: systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.take: 262-trial NMA ranks tirzepatide and CagriSema top for 1-year weight loss; bigger effect generally means more discontinuation, and QoL gains are small.
papers.result: Tirzepatide −14.9%, CagriSema −14.8%, oral sema −10.9% vs lifestyle

papers.title: Cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema) as an add-on to basal insulin in adults with type 2 diabetes (REIMAGINE 3): a phase 3 study
papers.take: Added to basal insulin, CagriSema lowers HbA1c ~1.7 pp vs placebo with 10–12% weight loss and no extra hypoglycaemia.

papers.title: Apitegromab for lean mass preservation during tirzepatide-induced weight loss: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial
papers.take: Anti-myostatin antibody preserved ~1.9 kg lean mass during tirzepatide weight loss — proof of concept; function outcomes not yet shown.
papers.result: Lean mass loss 1.9 kg less vs placebo

papers.title: Orforglipron for maintenance of body weight reduction: the double-blind, randomized phase 3b ATTAIN-MAINTAIN trial
papers.take: Switching from injectable tirzepatide/semaglutide to oral orforglipron preserved ~75–80% of lost weight vs ~40–50% on placebo — a credible step-down maintenance strategy.

papers.title: Elecoglipron, an oral small molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist in adults with type 2 diabetes (SOLSTICE): a phase 2b trial
papers.take: Another oral small-molecule GLP-1 RA with up to ~1.7 pp placebo-adjusted HbA1c reduction at 26 wk.

papers.title: Elecoglipron, an oral small molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist in adults with obesity or overweight (VISTA): a phase 2 trial
papers.take: Elecoglipron yields up to ~10 pp weight loss at 26 wk in dose-ranging; 25% did not complete assigned treatment.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of retatrutide in people with type 2 diabetes and inadequate glycaemic control with diet and exercise (TRANSCEND-T2D-1): a double-blind, randomised, phase 3 trial
papers.take: Retatrutide monotherapy in early T2D lowers HbA1c ~1 pp beyond placebo (placebo arm itself fell 0.8 pp).

papers.title: Tirzepatide for maintenance of bodyweight reduction in people with obesity in the USA (SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN): a multicentre, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial
papers.take: Dropping to tirzepatide 5 mg retains most weight loss (−16.6% vs −21.9% at MTD vs −9.9% stopping); 67% of stoppers regained ≥50% — dose de-escalation is a real option.

papers.title: Effects of SGLT2 inhibition on incident heart failure in carriers of cardiomyopathy-associated genetic variants
papers.take: T2D carriers of pathogenic cardiomyopathy variants (~1%) had a 13% absolute HF-hospitalisation reduction on dapagliflozin vs 1% in non-carriers — hypothesis-generating genotype-guided targeting.

papers.title: Pasteurized Akkermansia muciniphila MucT for weight loss maintenance in people with overweight and obesity: a controlled randomized trial
papers.take: Small trial: pasteurised Akkermansia cut weight regain by ~2 kg after a low-energy diet — biologically interesting, clinically marginal.

papers.title: Time-restricted eating for body weight management in women with polycystic ovary syndrome: a randomized controlled trial
papers.take: In PCOS, 6-h TRE without calorie counting matched daily calorie restriction (~4–5% weight loss) — a pragmatic alternative, not a superior one.
papers.result: TRE −4.3%, CR −4.7% vs control; TRE vs CR NS

papers.title: Once-weekly semaglutide versus placebo in patients with alcohol use disorder and comorbid obesity: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
papers.take: Semaglutide reduced heavy drinking days by ~14 pp more than placebo in AUD with obesity — the first robust RCT signal for GLP-1 RA in addiction.

papers.title: Semaglutide on liver fibrosis and heart outcomes in patients at high risk of liver fibrosis: a prespecified analysis of the SELECT randomized trial
papers.take: SELECT's MACE benefit holds in those at high FIB-4 risk; fatty liver index falls substantially.

papers.title: Evolocumab to Reduce First Major Cardiovascular Events in Patients Without Known Significant Atherosclerosis and With Diabetes: Results From the VESALIUS-CV Trial
papers.take: In diabetes without established ASCVD, evolocumab cut 3-P MACE by 31% (ARR 2.1% at 5 y) — supports PCSK9i for high-risk primary prevention.

papers.title: Efficacy and safety of once-daily oral orforglipron compared with oral semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes (ACHIEVE-3): a phase 3 trial
papers.take: Oral head-to-head: orforglipron superior to oral semaglutide on HbA1c (~0.45 pp at matched tiers) with no fasting requirement.

papers.title: Integrated community-based versus facility-based care for people with HIV, diabetes, and hypertension in sub-Saharan Africa (INTE-COMM): a cluster-randomised trial
papers.take: Community-based integrated chronic care maintained diabetes/BP standards without harming HIV outcomes — a model for decentralised long-term-conditions care.

papers.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease
papers.take: First phase 3 evidence of a kidney-protective agent beyond RAS blockade in T1D: 25% greater UACR reduction (surrogate) with manageable hyperkalaemia.
papers.result: UACR ratio vs placebo 0.75 (0.65–0.87); hyperK 10% vs 3%

papers.title: Bimagrumab plus semaglutide alone or in combination for the treatment of obesity: a randomized phase 2 trial
papers.take: Activin-receptor blockade added to semaglutide increased total weight loss (−17.8 kg vs −14.2 kg) with a more fat-selective composition.
papers.result: 48 wk −17.8 kg combo vs −14.2 kg sema vs −3.3 kg placebo

papers.title: Vitamin D supplementation before in vitro fertilisation in women with polycystic ovary syndrome: multicentre, double blind, placebo controlled, randomised clinical trial
papers.take: Correcting vitamin D deficiency before IVF in PCOS did not improve live birth — stop routine pre-IVF supplementation for this purpose.

papers.title: Tirzepatide on obstructive sleep apnea-related cardiometabolic risk: secondary outcomes of the SURMOUNT-OSA randomized trial
papers.take: Cardiometabolic gains in OSA on tirzepatide are mostly but not entirely mediated by weight loss (post hoc mediation).

papers.title: Weight regain after cessation of medication for weight management: systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.take: Stopping obesity drugs → ~0.4 kg/month regain and cardiometabolic markers back to baseline within ~1.4 y; regain faster than after behavioural programmes.
papers.result: Regain 0.4 kg/month; markers to baseline ~1.4 y

papers.title: Effects of lifestyle interventions in pregnancy on gestational diabetes: individual participant data and network meta-analysis
papers.take: Pregnancy lifestyle interventions cut GDM ~20% overall, but the effect depends on diagnostic criteria (none under NICE criteria).

papers.title: Management of Type 2 Diabetes, 2026. A Consensus Report by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) and the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD)
papers.take: Major update: reframes T2D care around multiple long-term conditions rather than glycaemia alone.
papers.date_note: Online date of Diabetologia co-publication; Diabetes Care issue date 2026-12-01

papers.title: 2026 EASD evidence-based clinical practice guideline for assessing and managing diabetes distress among adults with type 1 diabetes or type 2 diabetes
papers.take: First GRADE-based EASD guideline on diabetes distress: how and when to assess, and which interventions to offer.

papers.title: The Management of Type 1 Diabetes in Adults. The Updated 2026 Consensus Report by the ADA and EASD
papers.take: T1D consensus update centred on technology integration and therapies to delay stage 3 disease.
papers.date_note: Online date of Diabetologia co-publication; Diabetes Care issue date 2026-12-01

papers.title: The Transition of Youth With Diabetes From Pediatric to Adult Diabetes Care Services: A Consensus Report of ISPAD, EASD and ADA
papers.take: Tri-society consensus on structuring paediatric-to-adult diabetes transition — a template for local service policy.
papers.date_note: Online date of Diabetologia co-publication; Diabetes Care issue date 2026-12-01

papers.title: International consensus guidance for general population screening for islet autoantibodies to diagnose early-stage type 1 diabetes
papers.take: Consensus framework for general-population islet-autoantibody screening, with DKA prevention as the main justification.

papers.title: Secondary adrenal insufficiency prevalence in patients with euvolaemic hyponatraemia — analysis of a randomized controlled, parallel-group trial (standard care versus guideline based)
papers.take: ~3% of euvolaemic hyponatraemia is secondary AI, yet cortisol was checked in under 30% under usual care — measure cortisol before labelling SIAD.
papers.result: SAI 2.9%; cortisol measured 28.9% in standard care

papers.title: International Consensus on Clinical Trial Endpoints in Autosomal Dominant Osteopetrosis
papers.take: Delphi core endpoint set for ADO trials — readies the field for emerging therapies.

papers.title: Consensus on biomarker utility for ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome: a Pituitary Society Modified Delphi Panel
papers.take: Experts converge on late-night salivary cortisol for mild CS and post-treatment monitoring, and restoring circadian rhythm as a treatment goal; consensus was reached on under half of the statements.

papers.title: Long-acting growth hormone: an updated Growth Hormone Research Society consensus statement
papers.take: Short-to-mid-term efficacy of long-acting GH looks equivalent to daily somatropin when dosed properly; long-term safety data remain thinner (≤7 y, ~8000 people).

papers.title: Updated Dutch 2026 pediatric differentiated thyroid carcinoma guideline: aligning with Europe
papers.take: National guideline: total thyroidectomy without histology for BRAF-positive Bethesda V–VI nodules, selective RAI omission, minimal ultrasound follow-up.

papers.title: Central precocious puberty: an Endocrine Society clinical practice guideline
papers.take: Endocrine Society shifts to watchful waiting for thelarche at 7–8 y and observation before testing for most girls <7 y — a deliberate de-escalation.

papers.title: Diagnostic work-up in paediatric adrenocortical tumours: an international consensus
papers.take: First international Delphi pathway (41 statements) for evaluating suspected paediatric adrenocortical tumours.

papers.title: International Delphi-based consensus: therapeutic approaches for pediatric adrenocortical carcinoma
papers.take: Companion consensus on treating paediatric ACC; complete resection remains the cornerstone.

papers.title: The American Thyroid Association Multidisciplinary Consensus Statement on Ambulatory Thyroid Surgery
papers.take: ATA endorses same-day thyroid surgery for carefully selected patients with defined perioperative safeguards.

papers.title: American Thyroid Association 2026 Guidelines for Thyroid Disease in Preconception, Pregnancy, and Postpartum
papers.take: Full ATA update on thyroid disease from preconception to postpartum — the reference document for antenatal thyroid practice.

papers.title: ESPE and ESE joint clinical practice guidance for healthcare transition from paediatric to adult endocrine care
papers.take: Recommendations across 11 domains for paediatric-to-adult endocrine transition; complements the diabetes-specific ISPAD/EASD/ADA report.

papers.title: International guideline on genetic testing of children with short stature
papers.take: Algorithm for which children with short stature should get genetic testing, and which test.

themes.title: Obesity pharmacotherapy: from 'does it work' to 'which mechanism, which route, for how long'

points.text: Triple agonism arrived in phase 3. Retatrutide gave about 21 percentage points of placebo-adjusted weight loss without diabetes and about 12–14 points with T2D, plus knee OA pain and OSA benefits.

Calling retatrutide 'the most efficacious agent' compares across trials. No head-to-head against tirzepatide exists, and the BMJ network meta-analysis rates the emerging agents as low to very low certainty.

The amylin axis matured. CagriSema beat semaglutide 2.4 mg by about 6.5 points head-to-head. Lower CagriSema doses kept almost all of the efficacy. Petrelintide (amylin alone) showed unusually low GI toxicity.

Glucagon co-agonists split. Survodutide and mazdutide gave moderate weight loss with heavy GI burden in Western cohorts, but showed a liver-fat advantage (84% reached a ≥30% liver-fat reduction in SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD).
Oral small-molecule GLP-1 RAs multiplied: orforglipron, aleniglipron, elecoglipron and safiglipron. Orforglipron now has obesity, maintenance and CV-safety data.

Maintenance became the central question. Stopping drug leads to about 0.4 kg/month regain. Tirzepatide 5 mg keeps most of the loss (−16.6% vs −21.9% at maximum dose). An oral step-down retains about 75–80% of the lost weight.
Lean-mass-sparing adjuncts (myostatin or activin blockade) changed body composition in phase 2. Whether that improves function or outcomes is unshown.

Indications are widening beyond weight. Semaglutide reduced heavy drinking in alcohol use disorder, and setmelanotide worked in acquired hypothalamic obesity. Behavioural weight loss in older adults with AF did not move symptoms.

themes.title: Type 2 diabetes: oral incretins go head-to-head, CGM moves beyond insulin, and kidneys benefit

points.text: Orforglipron beat dapagliflozin and oral semaglutide on HbA1c in head-to-head trials (−0.4 to −0.75 points), and was non-inferior to glargine for MACE-4. It is a safety finding, not a CV-benefit claim.
CGM showed HbA1c benefit in non-insulin-treated T2D in primary care (−0.9 points) and in basal-insulin users (−0.5 points). This strengthens the case for wider funding.

Kidney outcomes: pooling SELECT, FLOW and SOUL gave semaglutide a kidney-composite HR of 0.84. Tirzepatide beat dulaglutide on kidney events in SURPASS-CVOT (exploratory analysis). Finerenone cut albuminuria in T1D.
Weekly IcoSema beat daily glargine for insulin initiation on HbA1c, weight and hypoglycaemia. CagriSema adds little glycaemic benefit over semaglutide 2.4 mg (−0.16 points).
The ADA/EASD 2026 consensus reframes T2D care around multiple long-term conditions. EASD issued its first GRADE guideline on diabetes distress.
Neutral and negative results: intensive SBP targets did not reduce dementia in BPROAD. Native GIP added to semaglutide did not improve glycaemia.

themes.title: Type 1 diabetes: technology first, immunotherapy setbacks, and screening goes mainstream

points.text: Switching straight from MDI to tubeless AID lowered HbA1c by 0.8 points in 13 weeks, with no pump-first step needed.
Low-dose IL-2 expanded Tregs but did not preserve C-peptide, a clean negative result for monotherapy at diagnosis.
Consensus documents: general-population islet-autoantibody screening, the ADA/EASD adult T1D update, and a tri-society transition report.
In low-resource settings, glargine was not superior to human insulin over 6 months. The analogue-first assumption depends on context.
In adult osteogenesis imperfecta, teriparatide plus zoledronate raised BMD but did not reduce fractures (HR 0.97).
Three months of romosozumab then denosumab matched 12 months of romosozumab for hip BMD. It is a small surrogate-endpoint trial, but it is a cost and access lever.
Secondary adrenal insufficiency causes about 3% of euvolaemic hyponatraemia, yet cortisol was checked in under 30% of patients under usual care.

Relacorilant (a GR antagonist) maintained BP control in Cushing's syndrome in a randomised-withdrawal design. The Pituitary Society Delphi favours late-night salivary cortisol for mild disease and monitoring.
PRRT (Lu-edotreotide) beat everolimus on PFS in GEP-NETs. Consensus documents were published on long-acting GH and paediatric adrenocortical tumours.

themes.title: Thyroid and reproductive endocrinology: guideline year

points.text: The ATA 2026 pregnancy and postpartum guideline is the main thyroid update. The ATA also endorsed ambulatory thyroidectomy for selected patients.
The Endocrine Society CPP guideline de-escalates: watchful waiting for thelarche at 7–8 years.
PCOS: vitamin D before IVF did not improve live birth, and time-restricted eating matched calorie restriction.
